ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   B. Use Selected Surahs to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Selected Surahs has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Selected Surahs with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
